title: The closure correction — four retrieval states stay distinct, unknown geometry fails closed, ONE transport authority, the revision participates in the load, the producer publishes only through the canonical provenance path, exact input hashes replace the placeholder, both credentials PROVEN STILL LIVE (state OPEN), and the tree cleaned of its own re-leak
author: Coder 2 (presentation layer)
directive: Operator directive R451-C2-CLOSURE (no C2.7 feature round; the architecture is frozen; a small, mandatory closure correction before C2 is accepted as production-ready). Directions A-I: retrieval-state truth (A), unknown-geometry fail-closed (B), the status/projection contradiction with exactly one authoritative resolution (C), the pinned revision in the actual load (D), the producer incapable of publishing without NONE_PRESENTATION_ONLY (E), exact input provenance replacing the MANIFEST placeholder (F), the DA3 SHA verified in-session and pinned in the real call (G), credential remediation without history rewrite (H), the full verification discipline then Constitution reread #2, commit, push, remote-SHA verification (I). No new visual models, no UI polish, no new benchmark dimension, no new abstraction, no package redesign.
round_question: Can the presentation layer still lie through a collapsed retrieval state, an unrecognized backend state, or a stale scientific projection on a transport-terminal record — and can the benchmark producer still publish a candidate whose revision is decorative, whose sidecar bypasses the canonical constructor, or whose inputs are 'see MANIFEST.json' placeholders — and are the historically exposed credentials actually dead?
answer: NO to the presentation lies (fixed and attacked), NO to the producer shortcuts (fixed and attacked), and NO to the credential assumption: BOTH credentials are PROVEN STILL LIVE, so the security state is OPEN, not resolved. Measured: the four retrieval states render four distinct truths including the measured positive count (a blocked-after-retrieval run no longer claims 'not reached'); an unrecognized geometry_state fails closed to PRESENTATION_STATE_UNAVAILABLE with zero scientific claims under BOTH found_something polarities; the run record's canonical status is THE singular transport authority (RUN_BLOCKED_* + a stale COMPLETED_CANDIDATE projection is INFRASTRUCTURE_PAUSED, never VISUAL_READY — the hole was real and is now closed with the authority documented, singular, and attacked); the Hunyuan weights download AT revision 70e803bf with the snapshot path asserted to BE that revision's tree; the producer's only publish path is make_sidecar -> validate -> byte-equality -> upload (six attacks + the placeholder attack all fail with zero uploads); the DA3 pin 4010e39f was re-verified live in the editing session and participates in BOTH real from_pretrained calls; and the fresh scan found the R451 scan records themselves re-leaked the full token values — redacted forward, tree CLEAN.

direction_A_retrieval_states.what: blockedInsightCards() preserves ALL FOUR typed retrieval states: NOT_REACHED -> 'Evidence retrieval not reached'; PENDING -> 'Evidence retrieval in progress' (never collapsed into not-reached); FAILED -> 'Evidence retrieval failed'; RETRIEVED -> the ACTUAL measured count (0 renders the measured zero; a positive count renders 'N sources retrieved' — the pre-fix code rendered a measured 12 as 'not reached', a lie exactly of the class the directive names); RETRIEVED-with-count-absent renders 'Retrieval executed' with the count explicitly unknown. One typed state is never silently translated into another.

direction_B_unknown_geometry.what: THE FAIL-CLOSED UNKNOWN: a geometry_state that is present but outside the known vocabulary (checked BEFORE every other geometry resolution) resolves to the NEW explicit presentation state PRESENTATION_STATE_UNAVAILABLE with detail 'the backend recorded a geometry/visual state (...) that this frontend does not recognize. No scientific claim is made'. It can NEVER become GEOMETRY_UNAVAILABLE (found_something=true) or TECHNOLOGY_NOT_ESTABLISHED (found_something=false) — both would be scientific claims manufactured by a frontend parse failure. TechStage structurally mounts NOTHING for the state: viewerUrl and the history swap compute null under it (the same lock the legacy state received in C2.6 §1), the R441 gate badge is suppressed, and a dedicated fail-closed hero (data-hero-unrecognized-state) is the only surface. Both directive attacks + the convincing-raw-fields variant are pinned by the UI battery; the vocabulary check it supersedes (the C2.1-era 'falls through honestly' pin) is disclosed as superseded in-file (Art. LXIV).

direction_C_one_transport_authority.what: THE AUTHORITY, now EXPLICIT and SINGULAR: the run record's canonical `status` is the ONLY transport authority. A transport-terminal canonical status (the RUN_BLOCKED_* family) is decisive: INFRASTRUCTURE_PAUSED, and NO user_state_view content can change that — not a stale projection, not a malformed one, not user_state COMPLETED_CANDIDATE. WHY it wins (documented in the mapping source): user_state_view is a DERIVED projection — a cache that can be stale or malformed; the Constitution forbids letting a summary outrank the underlying artifact (Art. XXIV) and forbids a transport-terminal state becoming a scientific state (Art. LXI). The pre-fix code let the stale COMPLETED_CANDIDATE projection sail past the projection-based rule and resolve to VISUAL_READY — a falsely ready scientific surface on a blocked-terminal run (the hole was REAL and demonstrable). The directive's EXACT contradiction fixture (RUN_BLOCKED_TRANSPORT + COMPLETED_CANDIDATE + finished/found_something/package_available true + geometry_state visual_complete + engineering_authority ENGINEERING) now resolves to INFRASTRUCTURE_PAUSED; the projection keeps exactly one unchanged job: classifying the scientific outcome when the record carries no transport-terminal marking. Positive control: status COMPLETE + the same ready payload still reaches VISUAL_READY (Art. V — not a universal rejector).

direction_D_revision_in_the_load.what: The Hunyuan candidate's pinned revision now PARTICIPATES in the actual download/load invocation: resolve_pinned_revision() proves api.model_info(MODEL_ID, revision=MODEL_SHA).sha == MODEL_SHA BEFORE anything downloads (a dead pin refuses the load); pinned_model_snapshot() downloads with snapshot_download(repo_id, revision=MODEL_SHA) and ASSERTS the returned snapshot tree is named by MODEL_SHA (the default-cache byte-path proof that the downloaded bytes ARE the pinned revision); from_pretrained() then loads FROM THAT SNAPSHOT PATH — the load can never float to latest main. The pre-fix comment claimed 'pinned revision via env' while the call passed no revision at all — the false comment is gone with the false behavior. The producer-path battery proves the revision reaches the download invocation (kwargs assertion), that a mismatched snapshot path fails closed, that an unresolvable pin performs ZERO downloads, and that the old unpinned call shape is deleted (Art. LXIV).

direction_E_canonical_provenance.what: The hand-built sidecar dict is DELETED (Art. LXIV disposition in this record). The producer's ONLY publish path is publish_candidate_output(): make_sidecar() (which stamps engineering_authority=NONE_PRESENTATION_ONLY) -> validate() -> a byte-equality recheck of output_hash against the uploaded file's actual sha256 -> upload. Any gap raises ProvenanceError BEFORE the upload callable is ever invoked, so the producer is structurally incapable of publishing without NONE_PRESENTATION_ONLY or with incomplete provenance. The six directive attacks ran against THE ACTUAL PRODUCER PATH (a recorder upload callable), not against provenance.py in isolation: missing authority (model_license=None -> no upload); wrong authority (a subverted constructor stamping ENGINEERING is rejected by the producer's own validate+authority guard -> no upload); missing model revision (the module pin blanked -> no upload); missing source hash -> no upload; missing input hash (None and {}) -> no upload; incorrect output hash (bytes mutated between hashing and recheck, simulated via a counted sha256_file double) -> no upload. Plus the Direction F placeholder regression: the exact 'see bucket MANIFEST.json' shape is rejected. Positive control: the full valid publish uploads exactly two objects and the sidecar validates via the canonical validator with output_hash equal to an independently computed sha256.

direction_F_exact_input_provenance.what: The 'see bucket MANIFEST.json' placeholder is REPLACED by the exact hashes of the bytes the job consumed: per case, the sidecar input_hash carries canonical input artifact paths -> sha256 of the downloaded point-cloud npz -> sha256 of the reference view png -> the preprocessing description (seeded 2048-vertex subsample, rng seed 0, center/scale normalization, ASCII PLY contract) -> sha256 of the derived conditioning PLY; and the record's case block now carries model_id, model_revision (the pin), generator_seed, hardware, output hash, and the sidecar's NONE_PRESENTATION_ONLY — the full replay chain: canonical input artifact -> exact input hash -> preprocessing -> model ID -> model revision -> seed -> hardware -> output hash. The publish path enforces the contract structurally: every hash entry must be sha256:<64 hex>; only the three chain-descriptive keys (two canonical paths + preprocessing) are metadata; anything else — above all any placeholder — raises before upload.

direction_G_da3_pin.what: The live-observed SHA 4010e39f3634a45bc60553321fb49fb760bd594e was RE-VERIFIED in the actual editing session (GET /api/models/depth-anything/DA3METRIC-LARGE/revision/4010e39f... -> sha == 4010e39f..., 2026-09-13T10:50:37Z, ungated public model) and is now pinned IN THE REAL CALLS: AutoImageProcessor.from_pretrained(MODEL_ID, revision=MODEL_SHA) and AutoModelForDepthEstimation.from_pretrained(MODEL_ID, revision=MODEL_SHA, trust_remote_code=True). The record template carries referee_model_revision + referee_model_revision_pinned_call=true + model_loaded_revision at load time. An unresolved pin fails the job as a typed NOT_RUN record — it can never float to latest main. The probe is NOT claimed as shipped evidence: the pin exists in the job the next referee run will execute; the run itself remains NOT_RUN on HF infra (unchanged from R449). One latent defect fixed in the same file (disclosed): the depth-signature metrics used np.percentile/np.abs/np.diff with NO numpy import — a NameError that never executed only because the job always blocked at model load first; the fix is load-bearing for the pinned path ever completing.
